subject: general
question:
F is the brother of G.

G is the husband of H.

H is the daughter of I.

I is the wife of J.

How is F related to J?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Given:

1) F is the brother of G.

2) G is the husband of H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8bbbe1aacad3d3f0af27a3145f094a6326e12dfc0a81c1ea03588aab0648a861.png] 

3) H is the daughter of I.

4) I is the wife of J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c2c1cc9bb4851c77fa0f31cc87bfb01fbce5616ca84401d66991e89101954865.png] 

Thus, F is J's daughter's husband's brother.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
